item.question: Why is Tikhonov regularization sensitive to noise in seismic data processing?
item.answer: Tikhonov regularization is sensitive to noise because it relies on minimizing discrepancies between observed and predicted data, which can be significantly affected by random variations introduced by noise, leading to less accurate results.
